-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchModel` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.evOfKv (r : Nat) (kv : EtcdKv) : mvcc.EvM :=
  if kv.createRev = W64 0 then
    { del := true,
      kv :=
        { key := kv.key, createRev := kv.createRev, modRev := W64 ↑r, version := kv.version, value := kv.value,
          lease := kv.lease },
      prevKv := none }
  else { del := false, kv := kv, prevKv := none }

theorem mvcc.logEvents_prefix {L L' : mvcc.Log} (hp : L <+: L') {lo hi : Nat} (hhi : hi ≤
    List.length L) : mvcc.logEvents L lo hi = mvcc.logEvents L' lo hi

theorem mvcc.watchEvents_prefix {L L' : mvcc.Log} (hp : L <+: L') (r : mvcc.WatchRange) {lo hi :
    Nat} (hhi : hi ≤ List.length L) : mvcc.watchEvents L r lo hi = mvcc.watchEvents L' r lo hi

theorem mvcc.watchEvents_empty (log : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) {lo hi : Nat} (h : hi ≤ lo) :
    mvcc.watchEvents log r lo hi = []

def mvcc.filtered (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (evs : List mvcc.EvM) : List mvcc.EvM :=
  List.filter (fun ev => fs.all fun p => !p ev) evs

theorem mvcc.logEvents_append (log : mvcc.Log) {lo mid hi : Nat} (h1 : lo ≤ mid) (h2 : mid ≤ hi) :
    mvcc.logEvents log lo hi = mvcc.logEvents log lo mid ++ mvcc.logEvents log mid hi

theorem mvcc.watchEvents_cmp {L L' : mvcc.Log} (hc : L <+: L' ∨ L' <+: L) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) {lo
    hi : Nat} (h : hi ≤ List.length L ∨ hi ≤ lo) (h' : hi ≤ List.length L' ∨ hi ≤ lo) :
    mvcc.watchEvents L r lo hi = mvcc.watchEvents L' r lo hi

theorem mvcc.watchEvents_append (log : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) {lo mid hi : Nat} (h1 : lo ≤
    mid) (h2 : mid ≤ hi) : mvcc.watchEvents log r lo hi = mvcc.watchEvents log r lo mid ++
    mvcc.watchEvents log r mid hi

def mvcc.etcdKvCountableW : Pos.Countable EtcdKv :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun k => Pos.Countable.encode (k.key, k.createRev, k.modRev, k.version, k.value, k.lease))
    mvcc.etcdKvCountableW._proof_1

def mvcc.watchEvents (log : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo hi : Nat) : List mvcc.EvM :=
  List.filter (fun ev => r.covers ev.kv.key) (mvcc.logEvents log lo hi)

structure mvcc.RespM : Type where
  w : Loc
  id : w64
  evs : List mvcc.EvM
  rev : w64
  cov : List Loc
  regs : List Loc
  idx : Nat
  compactRev : w64

def mvcc.WatchRange.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.WatchRange :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun r => Pos.Countable.encode (r.key, r.end?, r.startRev, r.id))
    mvcc.WatchRange.countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.logEvents_empty (log : mvcc.Log) {lo hi : Nat} (h : hi ≤ lo) : mvcc.logEvents log lo hi
    = []

def mvcc.RespM.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.RespM :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun r => Pos.Countable.encode (r.w, r.id, r.evs, r.rev, r.cov, r.regs, r.idx, r.compactRev))
    mvcc.RespM.countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.logEvents_succ (log : mvcc.Log) (m : Nat) : mvcc.logEvents log m (m + 1) =
    mvcc.evsOfRevM m (mvcc.stateAt log (m - 1)) (List.getD log m [])

def mvcc.evsOfRevM (r : Nat) (before : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : List mvcc.EvM :=
  List.filterMap (fun i => Option.map (mvcc.evOfKv r) (mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑r) before cs i)) (List.range cs.length)

def mvcc.EvM.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.EvM :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun e => Pos.Countable.encode (e.del, e.kv, e.prevKv)) mvcc.EvM.countable._proof_1

def mvcc.logEvents (log : mvcc.Log) (lo hi : Nat) : List mvcc.EvM :=
  (List.map (fun m => mvcc.evsOfRevM m (mvcc.stateAt log (m - 1)) (List.getD log m []))
      (List.range' lo (hi - lo))).flatten
